import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from scipy import stats
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# 1. Load datasets
mutations = pd.read_csv('cleaned_mutations.csv', low_memory=False)
gene_expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Identify PIK3CA-mutant patients
mutant_patients = set(
    mutations.loc[mutations['Hugo_Symbol'] == 'PIK3CA', 'bcr_patient_barcode'].unique()
)

# 3. Extract PIK3CA expression row using known Ensembl ID prefix
ensembl_prefix = 'ENSG00000121879'
rows = [idx for idx in gene_expr.index if idx.startswith(ensembl_prefix)]
if not rows:
    # Fallback: search for symbol in index if present
    rows = [idx for idx in gene_expr.index if '|PIK3CA' in idx]
if not rows:
    raise ValueError("PIK3CA gene row not found in expression data")
# Use the first matching row
pik3ca_row = gene_expr.loc[rows[0]]

# 4. Partition expression values by mutation status
all_samples = set(pik3ca_row.index)
# Mutation data barcodes match only the first 12 characters of sample barcode
mut_samples = {s for s in all_samples if s in mutant_patients}
wt_samples = all_samples - mut_samples

mut_exp = pik3ca_row[list(mut_samples)].dropna().astype(float)
wt_exp = pik3ca_row[list(wt_samples)].dropna().astype(float)

# 5. Summary statistics
def summarize(x):
    return pd.Series({
        'n': len(x),
        'mean': np.mean(x),
        'sd': np.std(x, ddof=1),
        'median': np.median(x),
        'IQR': np.percentile(x, 75) - np.percentile(x, 25)
    })

mut_sum = summarize(mut_exp)
wt_sum = summarize(wt_exp)
print("PIK3CA Expression Summary:")
print(f"Mutant (n={mut_sum['n']}): mean={mut_sum['mean']:.3f} ± {mut_sum['sd']:.3f}, "
      f"median={mut_sum['median']:.3f}, IQR={mut_sum['IQR']:.3f}")
print(f"Wild-type (n={wt_sum['n']}): mean={wt_sum['mean']:.3f} ± {wt_sum['sd']:.3f}, "
      f"median={wt_sum['median']:.3f}, IQR={wt_sum['IQR']:.3f}\n")

# 6. Statistical test (normality and group comparison)
alpha = 0.05
# Conduct Shapiro-Wilk only if group sizes are reasonable
p_mut = stats.shapiro(mut_exp)[1] if 3 <= len(mut_exp) <= 5000 else 1
p_wt = stats.shapiro(wt_exp)[1] if 3 <= len(wt_exp) <= 5000 else 1
if p_mut > alpha and p_wt > alpha:
    test_name = 'Welch t-test'
    stat, pval = stats.ttest_ind(mut_exp, wt_exp, equal_var=False)
else:
    test_name = 'Mann-Whitney U'
    stat, pval = stats.mannwhitneyu(mut_exp, wt_exp, alternative='two-sided')
print(f"{test_name}: statistic={stat:.3f}, p-value={pval:.3e}\n")

# 7. Visualization: boxplot and density plot
plot_data = pd.DataFrame({
    'expression': np.concatenate([mut_exp.values, wt_exp.values]),
    'status': ['Mutant'] * len(mut_exp) + ['Wild-type'] * len(wt_exp)
})

plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))
plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
sns.boxplot(x='status', y='expression', data=plot_data)
plt.title('PIK3CA Expression by Mutation Status')
plt.xlabel('Mutation Status')
plt.ylabel('Log2(FPKM + 0.001)')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
sns.kdeplot(data=plot_data, x='expression', hue='status', fill=True)
plt.title('Density of PIK3CA Expression')
plt.xlabel('Expression')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

from scipy import stats

gene_expr = pd.read_csv('cleaned_gene_expression.csv', index_col=0)

# 2. Identify PIK3CA-mutant patients
mutant_patients = set(
    mutations.loc[mutations['Hugo_Symbol'] == 'PIK3CA', 'bcr_patient_barcode'].unique()
)

# 3. Extract PIK3CA expression row (match symbol in index)
# Assumes gene identifiers include symbol, e.g., 'ENSG...|PIK3CA'
gene_index = [idx for idx in gene_expr.index if 'PIK3CA' in idx]
if not gene_index:
    raise ValueError("PIK3CA gene row not found in expression data")
# Use first match
pik3ca_row = gene_expr.loc[gene_index[0]]

# 4. Partition expression values
# Align patient barcodes: sample columns are TCGA barcodes of form TCGA-XX-XXXX
# Mutant and wild-type
all_patients = set(pik3ca_row.index)
wildtype_patients = all_patients - mutant_patients

# Get expression values, drop missing
mut_exp = pik3ca_row[list(mutant_patients & all_patients)].dropna().astype(float)
wt_exp = pik3ca_row[list(wildtype_patients & all_patients)].dropna().astype(float)

# 5. Summaries
def summarize(x):
    return {
        'n': len(x),
        'mean': np.mean(x),
        'sd': np.std(x, ddof=1),
        'median': np.median(x),
        'IQR': np.percentile(x, 75) - np.percentile(x, 25)
    }

mut_sum = summarize(mut_exp)
wt_sum = summarize(wt_exp)

print("PIK3CA Expression Summary:")
print(f"Mutant patients (n={mut_sum['n']}): mean={mut_sum['mean']:.3f} ± {mut_sum['sd']:.3f}, "
      f"median={mut_sum['median']:.3f}, IQR={mut_sum['IQR']:.3f}")
print(f"Wild-type patients (n={wt_sum['n']}): mean={wt_sum['mean']:.3f} ± {wt_sum['sd']:.3f}, "
      f"median={wt_sum['median']:.3f}, IQR={wt_sum['IQR']:.3f}\n")

# 6. Normality test (Shapiro)
# Use t-test if both normals, else Mann-Whitney U
alpha = 0.05
_, p_mut = stats.shapiro(mut_exp) if len(mut_exp) >= 3 and len(mut_exp) <= 5000 else (None, 1)
_, p_wt = stats.shapiro(wt_exp) if len(wt_exp) >= 3 and len(wt_exp) <= 5000 else (None, 1)

if p_mut is not None and p_wt is not None and p_mut > alpha and p_wt > alpha:
    test_name = 'Welch t-test'
    stat, pval = stats.ttest_ind(mut_exp, wt_exp, equal_var=False)

    test_name = 'Mann-Whitney U'
    stat, pval = stats.mannwhitneyu(mut_exp, wt_exp, alternative='two-sided')

print(f"{test_name}: statistic={stat:.3f}, p-value={pval:.3e}\n")

data = pd.DataFrame({
    'expression': np.concatenate([mut_exp.values, wt_exp.values]),
    'status': ['Mutant'] * len(mut_exp) + ['Wild-type'] * len(wt_exp)
})

plt.subplot(1, 2, 1)
sns.boxplot(x='status', y='expression', data=data)
plt.title('PIK3CA Expression by Mutation Status')

plt.subplot(1, 2, 2)
